title: Tempest Rain Gauge Bias vs Manual Gauge
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=weatherflow:obs
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(rain_mm) as station_rain_mm, max(manual_gauge_mm) as manual_gauge_mm by station _time
| eval rain_bias_mm=round(station_rain_mm-manual_gauge_mm,1)
| where abs(rain_bias_mm)>5
| sort - rain_bias_mm
description: Uses Tempest rain observations telemetry to monitor agreement between the station and a manual gauge in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for calibration drift before rainfall records stop being trustworthy, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tempest rain observations data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals agreement between the station and a manual gauge so you can spot calibration drift before rainfall records stop being trustworthy before it becomes annoying.
